caption:
A flashlight signal needs a full day to reach Voyager 1.

Fans flashed Morse code at the night sky. It spelled V-G-R, Voyager 1’s call sign.
Voyager 1 is about 26 billion km away.
Light needs one day to get there, and Voyager 1 passed that mark on 18 Nov.

What the astronomers say: at one light-day per 50 years, one light-year is about 18,250 years away for Voyager 1.

NASA picture: JPL, PIA26353. An artist’s concept of a Voyager probe, not a photo.
